SuccessStories.title: Success Stories
SuccessStories.subtitle: Meet the stories of greyhounds who found their forever home
SuccessStories.story1Quote: Luna has completely transformed our life. She is the sweetest and most affectionate companion we could have imagined. Every day she surprises us with her unconditional love.
SuccessStories.story2Quote: Adopting Max was the best decision we've made. He is incredibly calm and adapts perfectly to our routine. We can't imagine life without him.
SuccessStories.story3Quote: Bella arrived scared but over time has become the queen of the house. Watching her transformation has been the most rewarding thing we've experienced.

Foster.heroSubtitle: Become a temporary foster family and help us save lives
Foster.whatIsTitle: What does it mean to be a foster family?
Foster.whatIsDescription: Being a foster family means temporarily opening your home to a greyhound that needs a safe place while finding their forever family. It's a rewarding experience that allows you to directly help in their physical and emotional recovery, without the permanent commitment of adoption.
Foster.whatIsBenefit1: You help save a life by providing temporary care
Foster.whatIsBenefit2: The greyhound adapts better in a home than in a shelter
Foster.whatIsBenefit3: We cover veterinary costs and food
Foster.whatIsBenefit4: You can become an adopter if you fall in love with the greyhound
